title: Improved archery

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Improved archery is a status effect granted by wearing all three pieces of the Root armor set.
It increases the Bows skill by 15 but does not exceed the skill cap of 100.

Improved archery

Effects: Bows +15

Introduction. Improved archery is a status effect granted by wearing all three pieces of the Root armor set.
It increases the Bows skill by 15 but does not exceed the skill cap of 100.
